title: "Quickstart Guide"

Two approaches 


## Installation

**QuestionSafe** comes with command line tools, which would be good for most of the tasks. 

```bash
uvx install questionsafe
# pipx install questionsafe
```

Advanced usage may need the [Python API](python.qmd).

```bash
uv pip install questionsafe
# pip install questionsafe
```
